# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: CD14 gene length vs mean expression Pearson correlation
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 4L) stop("Expected counts, gene metadata, sample annotation, and output paths")

counts <- read.csv(args[1], check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gene_meta <- read.csv(args[2], check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sample_annot <- read.csv(args[3], check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

required_annot <- c("sample", "celltype")
required_meta <- c("Length", "gene_biotype")
if (!all(required_annot %in% names(sample_annot))) stop("Sample annotation lacks required columns")
if (!all(required_meta %in% names(gene_meta))) stop("Gene metadata lacks required columns")
if (ncol(counts) < 2L || ncol(gene_meta) < 2L) stop("Input tables have too few columns")

cd14_samples <- unique(sample_annot$sample[!is.na(sample_annot$celltype) & sample_annot$celltype == "CD14"])
if (length(cd14_samples) < 2L) stop("Fewer than two CD14 samples were annotated")
missing_samples <- setdiff(cd14_samples, names(counts))
if (length(missing_samples) > 0L) stop(paste("Annotated CD14 samples missing from counts:", paste(missing_samples, collapse = ",")))

count_gene_ids <- as.character(counts[[1]])
meta_gene_ids <- as.character(gene_meta[[1]])
if (anyNA(count_gene_ids) || any(count_gene_ids == "")) stop("Counts contain missing gene identifiers")
if (anyDuplicated(count_gene_ids)) stop("Counts contain duplicated gene identifiers")
if (anyDuplicated(meta_gene_ids)) stop("Gene metadata contains duplicated gene identifiers")

meta_index <- match(count_gene_ids, meta_gene_ids)
if (anyNA(meta_index)) stop("Some count-matrix genes are absent from gene metadata")

cd14_counts <- as.matrix(counts[, cd14_samples, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(cd14_counts) <- "double"
if (anyNA(cd14_counts) || any(!is.finite(cd14_counts))) stop("CD14 count matrix contains non-finite values")

gene_total <- rowSums(cd14_counts)
gene_mean <- rowMeans(cd14_counts)
gene_length <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gene_meta$Length[meta_index]))
protein_coding <- gene_meta$gene_biotype[meta_index] == "protein_coding"
keep <- protein_coding & gene_total >= 10 & is.finite(gene_length) & is.finite(gene_mean)

if (sum(keep) < 3L) stop("Fewer than three genes passed the requested filters")
pearson_r <- stats::cor(gene_length[keep], gene_mean[keep], method = "pearson")

result <- data.frame(
  metric = c("pearson_r", "n_cd14_samples", "n_retained_genes", "total_count_threshold", "biotype"),
  value = c(format(pearson_r, digits = 17, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
            as.character(length(cd14_samples)),
            as.character(sum(keep)),
            "10",
            "protein_coding"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(result, file = args[4], sep = "	", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.gene_meta.path)" "$(inputs.sample_annot.path)" result.tsv
